answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 37837 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it allowed to pay Zakat to Animal Charity firms? Question: My question is simple that does ISLAM allow us to pay some amount (not all) from Zakat to pay to Animal welfare and charity firms, those working in Pakistan for the sick and injured animals treatment? Answer ID: 37837 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 567/479/B=1433) It is unlawful to give the amount of Zakah for the treatment of the sick and injured animals. Zakah can be given only in the possession of the poor and needy people who do not have wealth. They have been declared to be entitled to receive zakah in the Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
